title: aspidium lobatum
intro: Aspidium lobatum, commonly known as the Chinese maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium lobatum include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and diuretic properties, making it useful in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
